name: activity-toast
title: Activity toast
description: A toast for what someone else just did: their avatar, the action, a time and View, merging bursts into one counted toast.
docs: Mount the house Toaster once, then call toastActivity({ actor, action, target, at, group, onView }). Events with the same group inside mergeWindow merge into one toast whose count updates in place; mergedLabel is the sentence for that, with {count} and {target}, and moreLabel words the overflow after two names, with {count}. An actor with self: true is skipped, so it never shows for the person's own actions. The toast pauses on hover and focus like every toast and is announced politely once.
